messages.text: Once you get your hands on one, swing by and see me and I'll teach you about Chips!
messages.zh: 等你弄到一件,就过来找我,我教你芯片是怎么回事!

messages.raw: §fShow me a §eSpecialized Farming Tool §fand I'll teach you about §9Chips§f!
messages.text: Show me a Specialized Farming Tool and I'll teach you about Chips!
messages.zh: 给我看一件专精农具,我就教你芯片的门道!

messages.text: You can get one from SkyMart.
messages.gloss: 英文的 You can get one from 在中文里并进后半句,首段留空。
messages.zh: SkyMart 就有卖。

messages.text: Well, well! You got yourself a real Farming Tool, huh?
messages.zh: 哟,不错! 你还真弄到一件正经农具了?

messages.text: These don't just sit pretty, they grow stronger the more you use 'em!
messages.zh: 它们可不是摆设,越用越强!

messages.text: Every crop you harvest gives your tool experience, leveling it up over time.
messages.zh: 你每收一株作物,农具就攒一点经验,慢慢就升级了。

messages.text: But here's the catch - once it hits Level 15, you'll need to upgrade it before it can keep growing. Same goes for Level 30.
messages.zh: 不过有个坎——到了 15 级,得先强化一次才能继续升。30 级也一样。

messages.text: Oh, and you might have noticed something new, Sowdust. You'll start earning it just by using your tool from now on.
messages.zh: 哦,你可能注意到了一样新东西:播尘。从现在起,只要用农具干活就能攒到它。

messages.text: This stuff is important because it lets you upgrade Chips, which will give you permanent buffs.
messages.zh: 这东西很要紧,拿它能升级芯片,而芯片会给你永久的增益。

messages.text: Here, take this, your first Chip. Go ahead and use the chip to unlock it.
messages.zh: 来,拿着,你的第一块芯片。用掉它就能解锁。

messages.text: Nice! I've added the Chip Menu to your SkyBlock Menu while you are on the Garden, so you'll have easier access to them from now on.
messages.zh: 不错! 我把芯片菜单加进你的 SkyBlock 菜单了(在花园里的时候),以后找起来更方便。

messages.text: You can now have as many Chips as you want, just keep upgrading them with Sowdust!
messages.zh: 现在芯片想要多少有多少,记得用播尘不断升级它们!

messages.text: Chips can be found all over the place, and once you unlock them, you can start upgrading them.
messages.zh: 芯片到处都能找到,解锁之后就可以开始升级了。

messages.text: And if you come accross duplicates of the same Chip, don't worry, you'll be able to upgrade them to EPIC and LEGENDARY rarity, boosting their maximum level and effectiveness even further!
messages.zh: 要是捡到重复的芯片也别急,可以拿来把它升到史诗和传说稀有度,等级上限和效果都会更进一步!
